name: defect-ledger
title: The defect ledger: the measured defects that were never planned, in one page instead of seven tasks
description: Consolidate the never-planned tasks - each a measured defect whose Requirements and Acceptance Criteria are still TBD - into one page under .trellis/spec/guides/, with each entry's measurement verbatim and its provenance, then archive those task directories so the open board holds worked-on things rather than placeholders. The page is walked by the citation door, so its file:line anchors cannot rot unobserved.
creator: aixi
